newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Nov 9.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Nov 9.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 1.440 million tonnes in the week ended November 9, down from 1.717 million the previous week, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said on Tuesday.
CANEGROWERS reported that for crushing week 23 of the 1996 season average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content fell to 13.53 percent from 13.92 the week before.
The latest week brought this year's crush to 35.52 million tonnes, up from 31.73 million tonnes at the same time in 1995.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended November 9 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-

1995 Summary - Total cane crushed 37.389 million tonnes (Qld 35.295 million, NSW 2.094 million), sugar produced 4.98 million tonnes 94 n.t., (Qld 4.73 million, NSW 244,629), sugar content (CCS) 13.12 percent (Qld 13.22 percent, NSW 11.41 percent).
